tools.name: get_methodiq_tool_guide
tools.description: Explain how to use MethodIQ Tools or one connected specialist in the user's language, including what to provide, the interaction steps, example requests, outputs and limits. Check tools/list for live availability.

tools.name: get_methodiq_task_status
tools.description: Check a MethodIQ task that continued in the background after the chat response window. Poll with the returned taskId until status is completed or failed.

tools.name: list_methodiq_tools
tools.description: Start here for MethodIQ Tools help or a natural-language request. With no arguments, return a compact live category summary. Then pass category for its connected functions and guidance. Pass category plus functionName only when the exact input schema is needed. Users do not need to know function nam

tools.name: render_methodiq_tool_directory
tools.description: Show the actual connected tool directory in an interactive panel. Includes required materials, schema details and a button asking host AI to prepare the selected tool input; does not execute analyses automatically.

tools.name: list_saved_diagrams
tools.description: List saved diagrams and server-controlled storage entitlement.

tools.name: save_diagram
tools.description: Save the current diagram subject to the account storage limit.

tools.name: copy_diagram
tools.description: Save an independent copy while preserving the source.

tools.name: delete_saved_diagram
tools.description: Delete only a user-requested saved diagram to free a slot.

tools.name: recover_diagram
tools.description: Recover the last automatically saved work in this workspace.

tools.name: list_diagram_versions
tools.description: List retained versions allowed by the server account plan.

tools.name: restore_diagram_version
tools.description: Restore a retained version with revision checking.

tools.name: list_diagram_templates
tools.description: Return numbered diagram templates with example graphs.

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create an editable diagram from a template or graph. Then call render_diagram_editor.

tools.name: get_diagram
tools.description: Read authoritative graph, revision, selection and feedback before editing.

tools.name: export_diagram_svg
tools.description: Export the exact current diagram revision as a self-contained SVG for presentation or document insertion.

tools.name: render_diagram_editor
tools.description: Show the template picker, or open an existing diagram by diagramId.

tools.name: apply_diagram_changes
tools.description: Apply atomic targeted changes. Revision must match get_diagram. Stable IDs cannot be renamed.

tools.name: set_diagram_selection
tools.description: Record selected node/edge IDs for subsequent chat feedback.

tools.name: submit_diagram_feedback
tools.description: Record user feedback and return a prompt containing selected elements. This does not itself start an AI turn.

tools.name: undo_diagram
tools.description: Undo or redo the last graph edit with a fresh revision.

tools.name: submit_product_feedback
tools.description: Save a user-requested bug report or feature comment in this workspace; not an AI edit request or an email.

tools.name: list_product_feedback
tools.description: Read this workspace's product comments for review or export.

tools.name: diagram_list_capabilities
tools.description: List diagram tool capabilities.

tools.name: normalize_graph

tools.name: export_mermaid_flowchart
tools.description: Export a graph packet as Mermaid flowchart syntax.

tools.name: export_graphviz_dot

tools.name: review_layout_plan
tools.description: Recommend scalable review views and collapse policy for a graph.

tools.name: analyze_graph
tools.description: Report structural cycles, isolated nodes, missing endpoints, and unreachable nodes. Conditions are not evaluated.

tools.name: extract_focus_graph
tools.description: Extract a neighborhood suitable for a focused diagram export.

tools.name: trace_path
tools.description: Return a shortest directed structural path with original edge conditions; does not evaluate respondent eligibility.

tools.name: list_chart_styles

tools.name: update_chart
tools.description: update chart. Deterministic automatic chart design using ChartFlow rules. Interpret supplied numbers only; no causality or significance. Alluvial excluded.

tools.name: apply_chart_style

tools.description: List survey visualization capabilities and copy-ready packet and tidy-row examples.

tools.name: surveyviz_build_overall_chart_spec
tools.description: Build an overall response-distribution chart. Supply packet, rows, or csv using the documented field contract; for tidy facts include an overall row such as group_var=total and group_value=total.

tools.name: surveyviz_build_comparison_chart_spec
tools.description: Build a group comparison chart for one response option. Supply packet, rows, or csv, then select the comparison with group_id/group_label and response/column_id.

tools.name: surveyviz_render_chart_svg

tools.name: surveyviz_render_chart_html

tools.name: insert_chart_into_pptx
tools.description: Transfer the exact current Chart Studio revision into a saved PPTX slide without downloading or re-uploading the SVG. Use documentId/documentRevision for a workspace PPTX, or deckId/deckRevision to promote a temporary deck into the workspace. The result opens the PPTX editor on the changed slide.

tools.name: insert_chart_with_interpretation_into_pptx
tools.description: Read the exact current Chart Studio revision, write one to three concise evidence-bound interpretation points, and place the editable vector chart plus those points into one PPTX slide in a single revision. Preserve the chart unit, source and warnings. Describe only values present in the chart packe

tools.name: insert_diagram_into_pptx
tools.description: Transfer the exact current Diagram Studio revision into a saved PPTX slide as a sharp self-contained SVG, then open the changed slide in the PPTX editor. Read get_diagram after human or AI edits and use its current revision. Do not ask the user to download and re-upload the SVG.

tools.name: create_deck
tools.description: create deck. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: import_pptx
tools.description: import pptx. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: get_deck
tools.description: get deck. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: update_deck
tools.description: update deck. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: undo_deck
tools.description: undo deck. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: select_slide
tools.description: select slide. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: submit_deck_feedback
tools.description: submit deck feedback. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: export_deck
tools.description: Export the current deck as a downloadable PPTX. Return the downloadUrl as a clickable link to the user. The private link expires in 10 minutes; export again if expired. Anyone with the link can download until expiry. No permanent ChatGPT file attachment is implied.

tools.name: render_pptx_editor
tools.description: render pptx editor. Updates require the current revision; read the deck before applying user feedback.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List PPTX tool capabilities.

tools.name: get_renderer_status
tools.description: Check whether server-side PPTX compatibility rendering is available. This does not claim Microsoft PowerPoint fidelity.

tools.name: render_deck
tools.description: Render 1-10 selected slides as PNG images for visual inspection. Uses a compatibility renderer; Microsoft PowerPoint remains authoritative.

tools.name: get_pptx_workspace_status
tools.description: Check whether the owner's PPTX document workspace is available and backed by configured persistent storage.

tools.name: save_pptx_document
tools.description: Save an uploaded PPTX once in the owner's MCP workspace and return a documentId for later reads and edits.

tools.name: list_pptx_documents
tools.description: List PPTX documents saved in the owner's MCP workspace. File content is not returned.

tools.name: get_pptx_document
tools.description: Read metadata for one saved PPTX document.

tools.name: open_pptx_workspace_editor
tools.description: Open a saved PPTX in the persistent editor with one or two slides selected for human and AI revision. This is a UI handoff and may include bounded picture previews; hosts should use get_pptx_document and read_pptx_part for ordinary AI inspection, then render only requested slides.

tools.name: read_pptx_part
tools.description: Preferred AI read path: read structured text boxes from 1-10 selected slides without uploading the PPTX again or returning picture preview payloads.

tools.name: render_pptx_part
tools.description: Render 1-10 slides from a saved PPTX document as PNG images for visual review.

tools.name: apply_pptx_patch
tools.description: Apply revision-checked text or style changes to at most two slides in a saved PPTX document.

tools.name: apply_pptx_structure_patch
tools.description: Add, remove, duplicate or reorder slides, and add, remove, move or resize text boxes on at most two slide positions while preserving the rest of the PPTX package.

tools.name: sync_pptx_document
tools.description: Store a human-edited PPTX as the next revision of an existing workspace document.

tools.name: undo_pptx_document
tools.description: Restore the preceding PPTX revision as a new immutable revision.

tools.name: export_pptx_document
tools.description: Export the current revision of a saved PPTX document as a private download.

tools.name: delete_pptx_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved PPTX document and all of its revisions from the owner's workspace.

tools.name: validate_slide_plan
tools.description: Validate a neutral slide plan.

tools.name: summarize_slide_plan
tools.description: Summarize deck size, warnings, and readiness.

tools.name: create_pptx_from_outline
tools.description: Create a downloadable PPTX file from a slide outline.

tools.name: analysis_estimate_propensity_scores
tools.description: Fit standardized L2-logistic propensity scores from pre-treatment numeric covariates. Returns coefficients and common support; predictive fit is not causal identification.

tools.name: analysis_diagnose_covariate_balance
tools.description: Report named-covariate standardized mean differences, variance ratios and KS statistics with an explicit balance threshold. Not a causal test.

tools.name: analysis_match_propensity_scores
tools.description: Optimal 1:1 no-replacement matching under a logit-SD caliper, retention, before/after balance and unmatched records. Outcome is optional and descriptive only.

tools.name: analysis_estimate_matched_effect
tools.description: Estimate a paired continuous mean difference or binary risk difference for a supplied fixed 1:1 match, with conditional inference and explicit limitations.

tools.name: analysis_run_propensity_score_matching
tools.description: Run the deterministic ATT PSM workflow: validate receipt, estimate scores, match outcome-blind, diagnose balance, estimate the matched effect, run a caliper sensitivity grid and return a reproducibility digest.

tools.name: analysis_fit_pls_regression
tools.description: PLS1/PLS2 regression with fixed components and fold-local scaling. NOT PLS-SEM. Independent rows only.

tools.name: analysis_analyze_correspondence
tools.description: Exploratory simple correspondence analysis of integer contingency counts, inertia and row/column coordinates.

tools.name: analysis_test_variance_homogeneity
tools.description: Median-centered Levene/Brown-Forsythe equal-variance test. NOT measurement invariance or equivalence.

tools.name: analysis_audit_reported_statistics
tools.description: Recompute exact p from supplied t/F/chi-square and df, flag numerical disagreement. NOT data or study validation.

tools.name: analysis_test_mean_equivalence
tools.description: TOST mean equivalence, independent Welch or paired t. User must specify equivalence bounds in original outcome units. NOT nonsignificance or equal variances.

tools.name: analysis_calculate_proportion_margin_of_error
tools.description: Estimate a normal-approximation margin of error in percentage points for a probability-sample proportion. Optional finite-population correction and design effect. No raw respondent data, weighting or bias correction.

tools.name: analysis_get_special_analysis_guide
tools.description: Read methods, examples, assumptions and limitations before analysis.

tools.name: analysis_get_classroom_demo_catalog
tools.description: Read the three Korean classroom demo scenarios, variables, questions and learning points before running a demo.

tools.name: analysis_run_classroom_demo
tools.description: Run a reproducible synthetic-data classroom analysis and return results, interpretation, checks and follow-up questions for the AI host to explain.

tools.name: analysis_get_analysis_summary
tools.description: Read the compact, code-verified summary and interpretation contract for a completed Analysis Studio result. Use this before requesting details.

tools.name: analysis_get_analysis_details
tools.description: Read one verified detail section only when the summary is insufficient. Never invent a section or recalculate supplied numbers.

tools.name: analysis_submit_analysis_report
tools.description: Save the final report written by the host conversation AI after it has read the verified summary and any necessary detail sections. The app never writes this narrative. Return the report link to the user after saving.

tools.name: analysis_get_analysis_recommendation_context
tools.description: Read one pending Analysis Studio question and its SPSS variable metadata so the host conversation AI can recommend an analysis method and variable roles. Row-level data are never returned. After deciding, call submit_analysis_recommendation.

tools.name: analysis_submit_analysis_recommendation
tools.description: Submit the host conversation AI recommendation for a pending Analysis Studio request. App code validates every variable name, type, category count and role conflict before the web form can apply it. This does not confirm or run the analysis.

tools.name: gwriter_start_gwriter_edit
tools.description: Open a user-supplied Markdown draft in the external gWriter GPT Editor. Use this when the user wants to revise AI-written text in a full editing window.

tools.name: gwriter_get_gwriter_edit_result
tools.description: Check whether an external gWriter editing session is complete and, when complete, return the immutable revised Markdown.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_methodiq_task_status, list_product_feedback · Private data: export_diagram_svg, set_diagram_selection, submit_diagram_feedback, approve_report_chart, export_deck, get_pptx_workspace_status, save_pptx_document, list_pptx_documents, get_pptx_document, render_pptx_part, apply_pptx_patch, sync_pptx_document, undo_pptx_document, export_pptx_document, delete_pptx_document, create_pptx_from_outline, analysis_match_propensity_scores · Public sink: submit_diagram_feedback, submit_product_feedback, submit_chart_feedback, insert_diagram_into_pptx, submit_deck_feedback, analysis_submit_analysis_report, analysis_submit_analysis_recommendation · Destructive: render_methodiq_tool_directory, delete_saved_diagram, apply_pptx_structure_patch, delete_pptx_document, analysis_run_propensity_score_matching, analysis_run_classroom_demo, analysis_submit_analysis_recommendation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_methodiq_task_status, list_product_feedback · Private data: export_diagram_svg, set_diagram_selection, submit_diagram_feedback, approve_report_chart, export_deck, get_pptx_workspace_status, save_pptx_document, list_pptx_documents, get_pptx_document, render_pptx_part, apply_pptx_patch, sync_pptx_document, undo_pptx_document, export_pptx_document, delete_pptx_document, create_pptx_from_outline, analysis_match_propensity_scores · Public sink: submit_diagram_feedback, submit_product_feedback, submit_chart_feedback, insert_diagram_into_pptx, submit_deck_feedback, analysis_submit_analysis_report, analysis_submit_analysis_recommendation · Destructive: render_methodiq_tool_directory, delete_saved_diagram, apply_pptx_structure_patch, delete_pptx_document, analysis_run_propensity_score_matching, analysis_run_classroom_demo, analysis_submit_analysis_recommendation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
